ex: 墙上悬挂着一幅画。
A painting hangs on the wall.
节日里，街上悬挂着很多红灯笼。
During the festival, lots of red lanterns hang over the streets.
use: Written; 挂 is the everyday word.

m: A **teacher** and **instructor** of a trade: a **master**, a skilled worker.
ex: 师傅，去火车站多少钱？
Driver, how much to the train station?
这位师傅修车修得很好。
This mechanic is very good at fixing cars.
use: Polite way to address drivers, cooks and repairmen.

m: **Grind** away at research and **send out** results: **research and development**.
ex: 公司正在研发新产品。
The company is developing a new product.
这种药研发了十年才成功。
This drug took ten years to develop.
use: Short for 研究开发; R&D.

m: The **power** in play on the **board**: the **situation**.
ex: 现在的局势很紧张。
The situation is very tense now.
大家都很关心那个地区的局势。
Everyone is concerned about the situation in that region.
use: For politics and wars; 情况 is everyday.

ex: 他被任命为校长。
He was appointed headmaster.
公司任命了一位新经理。
The company appointed a new manager.

m: **Hurry** until you **reach** it: to **rush to**, arrive in time.
ex: 医生很快就赶到了。
The doctor arrived quickly.
我们赶到车站时，火车已经开了。
When we got to the station, the train had already left.
use: 赶不到 "can't get there in time".

ex: 他在部队当步兵。
He serves in the army as an infantryman.
步兵跟在坦克后面前进。
The infantry advanced behind the tanks.
我们要确保大家的安全。
We must ensure everyone's safety.
请确保门窗都关好了。
Please make sure all doors and windows are shut.

m: The city **committee** of the **market** town: the **municipal Party committee**.
ex: 他在市委工作。
He works at the municipal Party committee.
市委书记今天来学校参观了。
The city Party secretary visited the school today.
use: Short for 市委员会; 市委书记 is the city's top official.

ex: 他说话带有一点南方口音。
He speaks with a slight southern accent.
这些话带有批评的意思。
These words carry a hint of criticism.
大家热烈欢迎新同学。
Everyone gave the new student a warm welcome.
会上大家讨论得很热烈。
There was a lively discussion at the meeting.
use: 热烈欢迎 "warm welcome"; 热烈的掌声 "loud applause".

m: The **spirit** and **feeling** in a face: a **look**, expression.
ex: 他的神情很紧张。
He looked nervous.
听完故事，孩子们露出了吃惊的神情。
After the story, the children looked astonished.
use: Written; 表情 is common in speech.

ex: 这次地震是三级。
This earthquake was magnitude three.
他通过了汉语三级考试。
He passed the Level 3 Chinese exam.
use: For ranks, exams and disasters: 三级风 "force-3 wind".

ex: 月亮的光华照在湖面上。
The moonlight shone on the lake.
这块宝石发出美丽的光华。
This gem gives off a beautiful sparkle.
use: Literary; also common in names: 光华路.

ex: 这是一种新的学说。
This is a new theory.
孔子的学说影响了中国两千多年。
Confucius's teachings influenced China for over two thousand years.
长江的航运很发达。
Shipping on the Yangtze is well developed.
这个港口是重要的航运中心。
This port is an important shipping centre.
心脏把血液送到全身。
The heart pumps blood round the body.
医生要检查一下你的血液。
The doctor needs to test your blood.
use: Formal and medical; 血 alone is everyday.

ex: 请大家依次进入。
Please enter one at a time.
同学们依次走上台领奖。
The students went up on stage in turn to get their prizes.
这是一家精品店。
This is a boutique.
这些都是博物馆里的精品。
These are all prize pieces in the museum.

m: A loanword for **club**: all **happy** in one **section**.
ex: 他参加了一个足球俱乐部。
He joined a football club.
学校有很多学生俱乐部。
The school has many student clubs.
use: Measure word 个 or 家.

m: A **book** of **pictures**: a **picture album** or atlas.
ex: 这本图册里有很多动物的照片。
This picture book has lots of animal photos.
我买了一本中国地图图册。
I bought an atlas of China.
西安的城墙很有名。
Xi'an's city wall is famous.
我们在城墙上骑自行车。
We rode bikes on the city wall.
use: Measure word 道 or 座.

ex: 吸烟损害健康。
Smoking damages your health.
这件事损害了公司的名声。
This incident damaged the company's reputation.
use: Often with 健康, 利益, 名声.

ex: 他的手上都是鲜血。
His hand was covered in blood.
这片土地上流过很多英雄的鲜血。
Much heroes' blood has been shed on this land.
use: Written and vivid; 血 is plain.

ex: 路上有一块大石头。
There's a big stone in the road.
孩子们在河边扔石头玩。
The children are throwing stones by the river.
use: Measure word 块. 头 here is a light suffix (tou).

ex: 他平日很少说话。
He usually doesn't talk much.
平日里我们很忙，周末才有时间。
We're busy on weekdays; we only have time at weekends.
明天早上八点在门口集合。
Assemble at the gate at eight tomorrow morning.
老师让大家在操场上集合。
The teacher had everyone gather on the sports ground.
今年的雨比以往多。
There's been more rain this year than in the past.
他跟以往一样，第一个来到办公室。
As usual, he was the first to arrive at the office.
他的剑法很好。
He's a fine swordsman.
这部小说里的剑法都很有意思。
The sword styles in this novel are all fascinating.
这里用水力发电。
Electricity is generated here by water power.
古代人用水力推动石磨。
People in the past used water power to turn millstones.
我们缺少经验。
We lack experience.
这个房间里缺少一张桌子。
This room is missing a table.
use: Close to 缺乏; 缺少 is often a countable thing.

ex: 皇帝身边有很多侍卫。
The emperor had many bodyguards around him.
侍卫拦住了门口的人。
The guards stopped the people at the door.
这条河全长三百公里。
This river is 300 kilometres long.
大桥全长两千米，是这里最长的桥。
The bridge is 2,000 metres long, the longest here.
这部电影很可怕。
This film is really scary.
最可怕的是没有人知道发生了什么。
The scariest thing is that nobody knows what happened.
use: Also figurative: 可怕的速度 "astonishing speed".

m: **Rise up** with **energy**: to **spring up**, become popular.
ex: 最近兴起了一种新的运动。
A new sport has become popular recently.
网上购物在这几年迅速兴起。
Online shopping has taken off in recent years.
遇到问题要理性对待。
Handle problems rationally.
他是一个很理性的人。
He's a very rational person.
辛亥革命以后，中国实行共和。
After the 1911 Revolution, China became a republic.
他们为共和制度奋斗了一辈子。
They fought all their lives for a republican system.

m: **Bear** and **carry on a pole**: a **burden**, to bear.
ex: 孩子的学费是一个很大的负担。
The children's school fees are a big burden.
这笔钱由公司负担。
The company will bear this cost.
你看那儿有只猫。
Look, there's a cat over there.
我昨天去那儿买了一本书。
I went there yesterday and bought a book.
use: Northern spoken; 那里 is standard.

m: **Stand in** and **manage**: to **act for**, an agent.
ex: 他是这家公司的代理。
He's this company's agent.
校长不在的时候，由他代理校长。
When the headmaster is away, he acts as headmaster.
湖面很平静。
The lake is very calm.
听到这个消息，她的心情一直不能平静。
After hearing the news, she couldn't calm down.
每种材料都有自己的特性。
Each material has its own properties.
这种植物的特性是不怕冷。
A characteristic of this plant is that it isn't afraid of cold.
一架直升机在天上飞。
A helicopter is flying overhead.
病人被直升机送到了医院。
The patient was taken to hospital by helicopter.
他的父母都是知识分子。
Both his parents are intellectuals.
很多知识分子关心国家的未来。
Many intellectuals care about the nation's future.
use: In China, broadly people with higher education.

ex: 最近他们的来往很频繁。
They've been in frequent contact recently.
这个地区地震很频繁。
Earthquakes are frequent in this region.
他当上了加州州长。
He became Governor of California.
州长发表了新年讲话。
The governor gave a New Year speech.
他的手臂受伤了。
He hurt his arm.
她伸出手臂抱住了孩子。
She put her arms out and hugged the child.
我们换个话题吧。
Let's change the subject.
天气是英国人最喜欢的话题。
The weather is the British people's favourite topic.
这里美得像人间天堂。
It's so beautiful here, like heaven on earth.
她说只想过平凡的人间生活。
She says she only wants an ordinary life in this world.
他有很多不良习惯。
He has a lot of bad habits.
长时间玩手机会带来不良影响。
Using a phone for a long time can have harmful effects.
use: Formal; before nouns: 不良习惯, 不良影响.

ex: 每日一练，进步很快。
Practise a little every day and you'll progress fast.
这家饭馆有每日特价菜。
This restaurant has a daily special.

m: The **sun** and the **moon**: also days and months, **time**.
ex: 日月如梭，一年又过去了。
Time flies; another year has gone by.
古人认为日月是天上最重要的东西。
People in ancient times thought the sun and moon were the most important things in the sky.
use: Literary; 日月如梭 "time flies like a shuttle".

m: Get to **see** someone in a **meeting**: to **meet with** officially.
ex: 主席会见了外国客人。
The chairman met the foreign guests.
总理明天将会见美国代表团。
The premier will meet the US delegation tomorrow.
use: Formal, for officials; 见面 is everyday.

m: **Join** into a full **set**: to **form a complete set**, supporting.
ex: 小区的配套设施很完善。
The housing estate has full supporting facilities.
这张桌子和椅子是配套的。
This table and these chairs are a set.

m: The **general** **value** of all that is **produced**: **gross product**, GDP.
ex: 今年的生产总值增长很快。
This year's gross product grew fast.
这个城市的生产总值排在全省第一。
This city's gross product ranks first in the province.
你不该这么说。
You shouldn't say that.
我昨天不该对你发脾气，对不起。
I shouldn't have lost my temper with you yesterday; sorry.

m: **Called** by a **name** it **claims**: **known as**, claimed to be.
ex: 桂林号称山水甲天下。
Guilin is said to have the finest scenery under heaven.
这家店号称是全城最好的面馆。
This shop claims to be the best noodle shop in town.
use: Can suggest the claim is not quite true.

ex: 街头有很多人在唱歌。
Lots of people are singing in the street.
她常在街头拍照片。
She often takes photos on the streets.
他从包里拿出一本书。
He took a book out of his bag.
我们要拿出勇气面对困难。
We must summon the courage to face difficulties.
use: Also figurative: 拿出办法 "come up with a solution".

m: **One** **mouth** of **air**: in **one breath**, in one go.
ex: 他一口气跑到了山顶。
He ran to the top of the hill without stopping.
我一口气看完了这本小说。
I read this novel in one sitting.
use: Before a verb it means "in one go".

ex: 水果里有很多维生素。
Fruit has lots of vitamins.
医生让我每天吃一片维生素。
The doctor told me to take a vitamin tablet every day.

m: Make the **whole** **orderly**: to **tidy up**, sort out.
ex: 我要整理一下房间。
I need to tidy up the room.
他把笔记整理得很清楚。
He has organised his notes very clearly.
use: For rooms, notes, data; 收拾 is more spoken.

ex: 杯子放在桌子边缘很危险。
A cup on the edge of the table is dangerous.
这个小城在沙漠的边缘。
This small town is on the edge of the desert.
use: Also figurative: 在…的边缘 "on the verge of".

ex: 这条河的深度是五米。
This river is five metres deep.
他的文章很有深度。
His articles have real depth.
use: Also as adjective: 深度报道 "in-depth report".

m: In the **middle** of the **city**: **in the city**.
ex: 城中有一条小河。
A small river runs through the city.
我们住在城中的老街上。
We live on an old street in the middle of town.
use: Written; 城中村 "urban village". Also a district name in Xining and Liuzhou.

ex: 大气污染越来越严重。
Air pollution is getting more and more serious.
这个房子设计得很大气。
This house is designed with real grandeur.
use: As an adjective (dàqi) it means "grand, classy".

ex: 到现在为止，一切都很顺利。
So far, everything has gone smoothly.
我们练习到大家都会为止。
We'll practise until everyone can do it.
请写下你的姓名。
Please write down your full name.
表上要填姓名、年龄和电话。
On the form, fill in your name, age and phone number.
use: For forms; 名字 is everyday.

ex: 眼下最重要的是找工作。
The most important thing right now is to find a job.
眼下正是吃西瓜的季节。
It's watermelon season right now.
我原本想今天去，但是下雨了。
I'd planned to go today, but it rained.
这里原本是一片农田。
This used to be farmland.
use: Close to 本来 and 原来.

ex: 宋代的瓷器非常有名。
Song dynasty porcelain is very famous.
苏东坡是宋代的大文学家。
Su Dongpo was a great Song dynasty writer.
年轻人应该多学习。
Young people should study more.
这家店很受年轻人的欢迎。
This shop is very popular with young people.
很多人在观看比赛。
Many people are watching the match.
观看演出的时候请关掉手机。
Please switch off your phone during the show.
政府推行了新的政策。
The government implemented a new policy.
学校正在推行垃圾分类。
The school is introducing rubbish sorting.
她长得很漂亮。
She's very pretty.
这件衣服真漂亮，你在哪儿买的？
This dress is so nice; where did you buy it?
use: Also "well done": 干得漂亮! "Nicely done!"

ex: 这条路通往火车站。
This road leads to the train station.
学习是通往成功的路。
Study is the road to success.
他对待朋友很真诚。
He treats his friends sincerely.
我们要认真对待这个问题。
We must take this problem seriously.
我每天早上听广播。
I listen to the radio every morning.
车站正在广播火车晚点的消息。
The station is announcing that the train is late.
请随身携带护照。
Please carry your passport with you.
乘客不能携带危险物品上飞机。
Passengers may not take dangerous items on the plane.
他是一位有名的画家。
He's a famous painter.
这个画家最喜欢画山水。
This painter likes painting landscapes most.
学校贴出了一个公告。
The school put up a notice.
请大家仔细阅读公告的内容。
Please read the notice carefully.
use: Formal; 通知 is more everyday.

ex: 他们家族很大。
Their family is very large.
这个家族在这里住了三百年。
This family has lived here for three hundred years.
use: Extended family; 家庭 is the household.

ex: 这里埋葬着很多古代帝王。
Many ancient emperors are buried here.
历史上的帝王都想长生不老。
Emperors in history all wished to live forever.
他是本地人。
He's a local.
我们去尝尝本地的小吃吧。
Let's try the local snacks.

m: The **law** as a **system**: the **legal system**, rule of law.
ex: 我们要加强法制教育。
We should strengthen education about the law.
国家的法制越来越健全。
The country's legal system is getting more complete.

m: **One** **head**: a head full of, or one (big animal).
ex: 她有一头长发。
She has long hair.
农民家里养了一头牛。
The farmer keeps a cow.
use: 一头 + hair; also measure word for cattle, pigs.

ex: 明日可能有大雨。
There may be heavy rain tomorrow.
会议推迟到明日上午举行。
The meeting is postponed to tomorrow morning.
氧是一种化学元素。
Oxygen is a chemical element.
这件衣服加入了很多中国元素。
This outfit includes many Chinese elements.
他明天要上法庭。
He's going to court tomorrow.
法庭上，大家都很安静。
Everyone in the courtroom was very quiet.
use: Courtroom; 法院 is the institution.

ex: 说不定他今天不来了。
Maybe he won't come today.
带上伞吧，说不定会下雨。
Take an umbrella; it might rain.
use: Spoken; close to 也许 and 可能.

ex: 喜马拉雅山脉是世界上最高的山脉。
The Himalayas are the highest mountain range in the world.
这条山脉从东到西有一千多公里。
This range runs over a thousand kilometres from east to west.
他把我视为好朋友。
He regards me as a good friend.
这种行为被视为不礼貌。
This behaviour is seen as rude.
人民打败了侵略者。
The people defeated the invaders.
侵略者给这里带来了很大的灾难。
The invaders brought great disaster to this place.
澳门离香港很近。
Macau is very close to Hong Kong.
很多游客去澳门看老建筑，吃葡式蛋挞。
Many tourists go to Macau to see old buildings and eat Portuguese egg tarts.
很多人聚集在广场上。
Many people gathered in the square.
这里聚集了全国最好的学校。
The best schools in the country are gathered here.
use: For people and things coming together.

ex: 这条路禁止车辆通行。
Vehicles are banned on this road.
节日期间，路上的车辆特别多。
There are lots of vehicles on the road during holidays.
use: Collective, formal word; not counted with 个.

ex: 你可以自由支配这笔钱。
You can spend this money as you like.
他的行为被情绪支配着。
His behaviour is ruled by his emotions.
use: Also "allocate": 支配时间 "manage one's time".

ex: 上海市是中国最大的城市之一。
Shanghai is one of China's largest cities.
她在上海市中心工作。
She works in central Shanghai.

m: **Believe** and **look up** to: **faith**, to believe in.
ex: 每个人都有信仰自由。
Everyone has freedom of belief.
他信仰佛教很多年了。
He has been a Buddhist for many years.
一颗炮弹落在了村子旁边。
A shell landed beside the village.
战争中用了大量的炮弹。
Huge numbers of shells were used in the war.
use: Measure word 颗 or 发.

ex: 这只小狗真可怜。
This puppy is so pitiful.
他工资少得可怜。
His pay is pitifully low.
use: 可怜 + 某人 "feel sorry for someone".

ex: 一公里相当于一千米。
One kilometre equals a thousand metres.
他一个月的工资相当于我三个月的。
His monthly salary equals three of mine.

m: Fall **into** a **pit**: to **sink into**, get caught up in.
ex: 他陷入了沉思。
He sank deep into thought.
公司陷入了很大的困难。
The company fell into great difficulty.
use: With bad states: 陷入困境, 陷入危机.

ex: 他是我们的老前辈。
He's one of our respected seniors.
我们要向前辈们学习。
We should learn from those who came before us.

m: Turn your **face** **towards**: to **face**, be aimed at.
ex: 这个房间面向大海。
This room faces the sea.
这本书是面向初学者的。
This book is aimed at beginners.
use: Figurative: 面向未来 "look to the future".

ex: 我们家每个月吃二十斤大米。
Our family eats ten kilos of rice a month.
东北的大米非常好吃。
Rice from the northeast is delicious.
use: Uncooked rice; cooked rice is 米饭.

ex: 这个小岛靠渔业生活。
This small island lives on fishing.
近年来渔业发展得很快。
The fishing industry has grown fast in recent years.
use: Compare 农业, 林业, 牧业.

ex: 听到这个消息，我无比高兴。
I was overjoyed to hear the news.
那里的风景美丽无比。
The scenery there is incomparably beautiful.
我们的研究经费不够。
We don't have enough research funding.
学校用这笔经费买了新电脑。
The school used these funds to buy new computers.
use: For organisations; 费用 is general "cost".

ex: 清朝是中国最后一个王朝。
The Qing was China's last dynasty.
这座房子是清朝的时候建的。
This house was built in the Qing dynasty.
他是这家公司的总经理。
He's the general manager of this company.
总经理下午要开会，现在没空。
The general manager has a meeting this afternoon and is busy now.
use: Often shortened to 老总 or 总.

ex: 老师带领学生参观博物馆。
The teacher led the students round the museum.
在他的带领下，球队赢了比赛。
Under his leadership, the team won the match.
use: 在…的带领下 "under the leadership of".

ex: 他下个月回国。
He's going back to his country next month.
留学五年以后，她终于回国了。
After five years studying abroad, she finally returned home.
他抬头看了看天空。
He looked up at the sky.
上课的时候，请抬头看黑板。
In class, please look up at the board.
长江沿岸有很多城市。
There are many cities along the Yangtze.
地中海沿岸的气候很舒服。
The Mediterranean coast has a pleasant climate.
商店晚上十点关闭。
The shop closes at 10 p.m.
这家工厂去年关闭了。
This factory closed down last year.
use: Formal; 关 is everyday. Also "shut down" a program.

ex: 学生们去政府请愿。
The students went to petition the government.
他们写了一封请愿书。
They wrote a petition.
他负责收集情报。
He's responsible for gathering intelligence.
这份情报非常重要。
This intelligence is very important.
use: Mostly military or spy; 信息 is general.

ex: 这本书在国内外都很受欢迎。
This book is popular at home and abroad.
国内外的游客都喜欢来这里。
Tourists from China and abroad all like coming here.

m: **Shake** it and **shed** it: to **break free of**.
ex: 他终于摆脱了困境。
He finally got out of his difficulties.
我想摆脱这种无聊的生活。
I want to escape this boring life.
use: With 困难, 贫困, 束缚.

ex: 他在一家外贸公司工作。
He works at a foreign trade company.
这个城市的外贸发展得很快。
This city's foreign trade is growing fast.

m: **Bear** what you **consented** to: to **promise**, a promise.
ex: 他承诺明天还钱。
He promised to pay the money back tomorrow.
你要遵守自己的承诺。
You must keep your promise.
藏族人喜欢喝酥油茶。
Tibetans like drinking butter tea.
她是一个会唱歌的藏族姑娘。
She's a Tibetan girl who sings well.

m: A **matter**, with the northern **-r**: a **thing**, business.
ex: 你有什么事儿？
What's up?
别担心，这点事儿我能做好。
Don't worry, I can handle this little job.
use: Northern spoken; 事 or 事情 elsewhere.

ex: 这幅画的手法很新。
This painting's technique is fresh.
骗子的手法越来越多。
Swindlers have more and more tricks.
她很喜欢绘画。
She loves painting.
这次绘画比赛有很多孩子参加。
Many children took part in the painting contest.
use: Formal noun; 画画 is spoken.

ex: 你要想清楚其中的利害。
Think clearly about the pros and cons.
这件事关系到大家的利害。
This affects everyone's interests.
use: As lìhai (also 厉害) it means "fierce, impressive".

m: The **head** of the **heart**: **in one's heart**, on one's mind.
ex: 一种温暖涌上心头。
A feeling of warmth welled up in my heart.
这件事一直压在我的心头。
This matter has been weighing on my mind.
这是一辆装甲车。
This is an armoured car.
士兵坐在装甲车里很安全。
Soldiers are safe inside armoured vehicles.
他小时候家里很贫困。
His family was very poor when he was young.
政府帮助很多人摆脱了贫困。
The government helped many people escape poverty.
他对工作很不满。
He's very unhappy with his job.
顾客对服务表示不满。
The customer complained about the service.
use: 对…不满 "be unhappy with". Also "under": 不满十八岁.

ex: 这件衣服是天然纤维做的。
This garment is made of natural fibre.
多吃蔬菜可以补充纤维。
Eating more vegetables gives you fibre.
世上无难事，只怕有心人。
Nothing is hard in this world if you set your mind to it.
妈妈是世上最爱我的人。
Mum is the person who loves me most in the world.
use: Spoken and literary; 世界上 is fuller.

ex: 伊斯兰教有很多信徒。
Islam has many followers.
他们家信伊斯兰教，不吃猪肉。
Their family is Muslim and doesn't eat pork.
湖南省的省会是长沙。
The capital of Hunan Province is Changsha.
湖南省的菜很辣。
Food in Hunan Province is very spicy.
use: "South of Dongting Lake"; short name 湘.

ex: 街上的人很多。
There are lots of people on the street.
我在街上遇到了一个老同学。
I ran into an old classmate on the street.
use: Also "in town": 上街 "go into town".

ex: 何必这么着急呢？
Why be in such a hurry?
一点小事，你何必生气？
It's a small thing; why get angry?
这家商店卖女士服装。
This shop sells women's clothing.
演员们穿着漂亮的服装上台了。
The actors went on stage in beautiful costumes.
use: Formal and collective; 衣服 is everyday.

ex: 火箭把卫星送上了天。
The rocket sent the satellite into space.
看，那枚火箭飞得真快！
Look how fast that rocket is going!

m: **Writing** that gives an **opinion**: a **paper** or thesis.
ex: 他正在写毕业论文。
He's writing his graduation thesis.
这篇论文发表在一本有名的杂志上。
This paper was published in a famous journal.
你喜欢哪个颜色？
Which colour do you like?
我不知道哪个是你的包。
I don't know which bag is yours.
use: Spoken nǎge or něige; also "who": 哪个是老师?

ex: 他在射击比赛中得了第一。
He came first in the shooting competition.
士兵们正在练习射击。
The soldiers are practising shooting.
江夏在武汉的南边。
Jiangxia is in the south of Wuhan.
周末我们去江夏的湖边玩。
At the weekend we went to the lakes in Jiangxia.
请你协助我完成这个工作。
Please help me finish this work.
警察在调查，希望大家协助。
The police are investigating and ask for everyone's help.
他是一名共产党员。
He's a Communist Party member.
这个村有二十个党员。
This village has twenty Party members.
这是我媳妇。
This is my wife.
他娶了一个好媳妇。
He married a good wife.
那边有一个超市。
There's a supermarket over there.
你那边天气怎么样？
What's the weather like where you are?
地震毁坏了很多房屋。
The earthquake destroyed many houses.
这一带的房屋都很老了。
The buildings around here are all very old.
use: Formal and collective; 房子 is everyday.

ex: 心脏是人体重要的器官。
The heart is an important organ of the body.
他死后捐献了自己的器官。
After his death he donated his organs.
use: Body organs; not the musical instrument (管风琴).

ex: 她在电影里演一个老师的角色。
She plays a teacher in the film.
父母在孩子成长中扮演重要的角色。
Parents play an important role in a child's growth.
use: Read juésè. 扮演角色 "play a role".

ex: 他们英勇地抵抗敌人。
They bravely resisted the enemy.
多运动可以提高身体的抵抗力。
Exercising more can improve your resistance to illness.
东湖是武汉最大的湖。
East Lake is the largest lake in Wuhan.
周末很多人去东湖边骑车。
At weekends many people cycle by East Lake.
use: Also a district name in Nanchang.

ex: 哈哈，你说得太对了！
Ha ha, you're so right!
他听了笑话，哈哈大笑起来。
He heard the joke and roared with laughter.

m: **Calm** and **badge**: **Anhui**, a province in east China.
ex: 黄山在安徽。
Mount Huangshan is in Anhui.
安徽的老房子有白墙黑瓦。
Old houses in Anhui have white walls and black tiles.
他是一名二级运动员。
He's a second-grade athlete.
这家医院是二级医院。
This hospital is a level-two hospital.
他调到省委工作了。
He was transferred to the provincial Party committee.
省委书记今天来这里考察。
The provincial Party secretary came here today on an inspection.
use: 省委书记 is the province's top official.

ex: 他不幸受了伤。
Unfortunately, he was injured.
听到这个不幸的消息，大家都很难过。
Everyone was sad to hear the unfortunate news.
use: Also euphemism: 不幸去世 "sadly passed away".

ex: 今年工业增加值增长了百分之八。
Industrial value added grew eight percent this year.
这个行业的增加值越来越高。
Value added in this industry keeps rising.
恩施在湖北省西南部。
Enshi is in southwestern Hubei.
恩施的大峡谷非常漂亮。
Enshi's Grand Canyon is beautiful.
use: Home of the Tujia and Miao peoples.

ex: 这种充电器是通用的。
This charger fits all devices.
英语是国际通用的语言。
English is a language used internationally.
use: Also 通用 + noun: 通用语言.

ex: 房间很干净。
The room is very clean.
吃饭前要把手洗干净。
Wash your hands clean before eating.
use: Also result: 洗干净, 擦干净.

ex: 这个工匠做的家具很漂亮。
The furniture this craftsman makes is beautiful.
我们要学习工匠精神。
We should learn the craftsman's spirit.
这座老工厂改建成了博物馆。
This old factory has been turned into a museum.
学校正在改建图书馆。
The school is rebuilding its library.
长江水系非常大。
The Yangtze river system is huge.
这个城市的水系很发达。
This city has a rich network of waterways.
他会说阿拉伯语。
He can speak Arabic.
我们用的数字叫阿拉伯数字。
The numbers we use are called Arabic numerals.
use: 阿拉伯人 "Arab"; 阿拉伯语 "Arabic".

ex: 我把他当作好朋友。
I think of him as a good friend.
别把我的话当作耳边风。
Don't let my words go in one ear and out the other.
他天天跑步。
He runs every day.
我们天天见面，却很少聊天。
We see each other every day but rarely chat.
我们可以通过很多渠道了解信息。
We can get information through many channels.
农民挖了一条渠道引水灌田。
The farmers dug a ditch to bring water to the fields.
use: Mostly figurative: 销售渠道 "sales channels".

ex: 当今世界变化很快。
Today's world changes quickly.
他是当今最有名的作家之一。
He's one of the most famous writers today.
他们在路上遭遇了大雨。
They ran into heavy rain on the way.
听了他的遭遇，大家都很同情他。
Everyone felt for him after hearing what had happened to him.
我在网上看了一个视频。
I watched a video online.
周末我常和家人视频聊天。
At weekends I often video-chat with my family.
这里发现了一座古墓。
An ancient tomb was found here.
古墓里有很多珍贵的东西。
There were many precious things in the old tomb.
他接过了我手里的包。
He took the bag from my hand.
她笑着接过了花，说了声谢谢。
She took the flowers with a smile and said thank you.
use: Also figurative: 接过任务 "take over a task".

ex: 双方达成了协议。
Both sides reached an agreement.
经过讨论，大家终于达成了一致。
After discussion, everyone finally reached a consensus.
use: With 协议, 一致, 目标.

ex: 你喜欢什么样的人？
What kind of person do you like?
我不知道他是什么样的人。
I don't know what sort of person he is.
今天的天空特别蓝。
The sky is especially blue today.
晚上的天空有很多星星。
There are many stars in the night sky.
use: Written and descriptive; 天 alone is spoken.

ex: 或许他已经走了。
Perhaps he has already left.
这个办法或许能解决问题。
This method might solve the problem.
use: Close to 也许; slightly more written.

ex: 他很有音乐才能。
He has a lot of musical talent.
这份工作可以发挥你的才能。
This job lets you use your talents.
use: Careful: 才能 + verb can also mean "only then can".

ex: 这里有很多中外游客。
There are many Chinese and foreign tourists here.
这本书介绍了中外文化的不同。
This book introduces the differences between Chinese and foreign cultures.
use: Before nouns: 中外合作 "Sino-foreign cooperation".

ex: 杭州是一座历史名城。
Hangzhou is a famous historic city.
这次旅行我们去了好几座文化名城。
On this trip we visited several famous cultural cities.
use: 历史文化名城 "famous historical city".

m: An **economy** run by the **market**: a **market economy**.
ex: 中国实行市场经济。
China has a market economy.
在市场经济中，价格由市场决定。
In a market economy, prices are set by the market.
这个县管辖十个镇。
This county administers ten towns.
这件事不归我们管辖。
This matter isn't under our jurisdiction.
他有两个子女。
He has two children.
父母都希望子女过得好。
Parents all want their children to do well.
机场正在扩建。
The airport is being extended.
学校扩建以后可以多收学生。
After it's extended, the school can take more students.
他能否参加比赛还不知道。
It's not yet known whether he can take part in the match.
请问你能否帮我一个忙？
Could you do me a favour?
公司派他去采购原料。
The company sent him to buy raw materials.
她在一家超市做采购。
She works as a buyer for a supermarket.
他们个个都很能干。
Every one of them is very capable.
这些苹果个个又大又红。
Every one of these apples is big and red.
use: Before 都; same as 每个.

ex: 保护病人是医生的职责。
Protecting patients is a doctor's duty.
每个人都要尽到自己的职责。
Everyone should fulfil their own duties.
两人拿着兵刃打了起来。
The two picked up their weapons and fought.
武侠小说里有各种各样的兵刃。
Wuxia novels have all kinds of weapons.
大家在会议室议事。
Everyone is discussing business in the meeting room.
村里有一个议事会，专门讨论村里的事。
The village has a council to discuss village affairs.

m: The **head** and **neck** of a group: a **chief**, leader.
ex: 他是这个部落的首领。
He's the chief of this tribe.
强盗的首领被抓住了。
The leader of the bandits was caught.
use: For tribes and gangs; 领导 for normal organisations.

ex: 这个故事让我很感动。
This story really moved me.
他的话感动了在场的每一个人。
His words touched everyone there.
use: Pattern 让/使某人感动 or 感动某人.

ex: 一支舰队出海了。
A fleet has put out to sea.
郑和的舰队到过很多国家。
Zheng He's fleet visited many countries.
农民在池塘里放了很多鱼苗。
The farmer put lots of fry in the pond.
这些鱼苗长大要半年时间。
These young fish take half a year to grow.

m: Rays of **light** sharp as **awns**: **rays of light**.
ex: 太阳发出耀眼的光芒。
The sun gives off dazzling rays.
她的眼睛里闪着幸福的光芒。
Her eyes shone with happiness.
一位老者坐在门口晒太阳。
An old man was sitting at the door in the sun.
那位老者给我们指了路。
That old man showed us the way.
警察封锁了这条街。
The police sealed off the street.
大雪封锁了山路。
Heavy snow blocked the mountain road.
这种蘑菇不能食用。
This mushroom isn't edible.
请在三天之内食用。
Please eat within three days.
use: Formal, on labels: 食用油 "cooking oil".

ex: 他感到腿部疼痛。
He felt pain in his leg.
这种药可以减轻疼痛。
This medicine can ease the pain.
use: Formal and medical; 疼 is spoken.

ex: 请尽快回复我。
Please reply as soon as possible.
你生病了，要尽快去看医生。
You're ill; you should see a doctor as soon as you can.
